frozen_artifact_evidence.exploitation_evidence: A partially filled short record has no associated short order, which makes it impossible for the user to exit the short position or perform liquidation operations.
frozen_artifact_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: After the call of matchIncomingSell(), make the Short Record reach the fully filled (SR.FullyFilled) state.
frozen_artifact_evidence.root_cause_evidence: After the purchase order is matched, when the ERC quantity is lower than the defined minimum value, the order will not be added to the market for initialization.
